name: Bill Splitter App
description: A full-stack, multi-user web app for splitting bills between groups, with authenticated login, a relational database and a Flask REST API behind a Jinja2/Bootstrap front-end.

name: Data Structures & Algorithms Visualiser
description: An interactive learning tool for A-level students that animates tree traversals, BFS/DFS, sorts and searches step by step, with a 60-question self-test bank. A-level NEA, graded 69/75.

name: Astro Pi Mission Space Lab
description: Led a four-person team calculating the speed of the ISS from on-board imagery; an alpha mask to remove cloud-induced errors improved the calculation by 32%.
